places.name: Paris
places.what: Born at 3 rue du Jardinet; his father died on 30 December, three months later. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Paris (Conservatoire)
places.what: Organ with François Benoist from 1848, first prize in 1851; composition under Halévy from 1851. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Paris (La Madeleine)
places.what: Organist of La Madeleine for twenty years; he resigned the loft in 1877 after Albert Libon’s legacy. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Paris (École Niedermeyer)
places.what: Piano professor at the École Niedermeyer; Fauré was among his pupils. Coordinates mark the centre of the town or site and do not identify a particular building.

places.name: Paris (Société nationale de musique)
places.what: Founded the Société nationale de musique with Romain Bussine; motto Ars Gallica. Coordinates mark the centre of the town or site and do not identify a particular building.

places.name: London
places.what: Left Paris when the Commune was proclaimed, in danger as a former national guardsman and the Madeleine’s organist, and stayed away until the end of May; gave concerts and wrote songs. Coordinates mark the centre of the town or site and do not identify a particular building.

places.name: Le Cateau-Cambrésis
places.what: Married Marie-Laure Truffot here. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Saint Petersburg
places.what: Concert tour of Moscow and Saint Petersburg; met Tchaikovsky and Anton Rubinstein. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Weimar
places.what: Samson et Dalila was first performed at the Grand-Ducal Theatre, in German, under Eduard Lassen, as Liszt had promised. Coordinates mark the centre of the town or site, not a building.

places.name: La Bourboule
places.what: He and his wife separated for good during a stay here. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Chrudim
places.what: Withdrew here after the Berlin concert was disrupted and wrote Le Carnaval des animaux. Coordinates mark the centre of the town or site and do not identify a particular building.

places.name: London (St James’s Hall)
places.what: Conducted the first performance of the Third Symphony for the Royal Philharmonic Society. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Las Palmas
places.what: Reported in the Canary Islands in April 1890, recognised from a newspaper portrait while travelling as Charles Sannois; he wintered in the Canary Islands many times. Coordinates mark Las Palmas, not the place of the sighting.

places.name: Mount Lavinia
places.what: Three months in Ceylon, staying at Mount Lavinia near Colombo and at Kandy; studied botany. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Luxor
places.what: Visited Luxor and Karnak with the painter Georges Clairin; finished his Second Violin Sonata here in mid-March. Coordinates mark the centre of the town or site, not a particular building.

sources.title: Peter Jost, preface to Henle HN 1144 (2018)

places.name: Cairo
places.what: Wrote the Piano Concerto No. 5 in about three weeks. Coordinates mark the centre of the town or site and do not identify a particular building.

sources.title: Peter Jost, preface to Henle HN 1144 (2018)

places.name: San Francisco
places.what: Represented French artists at the Panama–Pacific Exposition; gave recitals and conducted three concerts of his works. Coordinates mark the town or site centre; they do not mark a specific building.

places.name: Dieppe
places.what: Gave his farewell recital at the casino on 6 August, after seventy-five years as a concert artist; the town holds his museum. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Algiers
places.what: Died in the evening at the Hôtel Oasis, where he had been living since 4 December. Coordinates mark the town or site centre, not a building.

places.name: Montparnasse Cemetery
places.what: Buried in the chapel he had built for his children, after a national funeral at La Madeleine. Coordinates mark the centre of the town or site and do not identify a particular building.
